description: This file contains prototypes, macros, and data structures for memory management functions used in the qhull library, including memory allocation, freeing, and statistics tracking.

methods.name: qh_memalloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of a specified size, possibly using optimized quick-fit or tracing methods.

methods.name: qh_memcheck
methods.description: Checks the integrity of the memory management system.

methods.name: qh_memfree
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory object.

methods.name: qh_memfreeshort
methods.description: Frees short memory buffers and updates statistics.

methods.name: qh_meminit
methods.description: Initializes the memory management system with error reporting.

methods.name: qh_meminitbuffers
methods.description: Sets up memory buffers with specified alignment and size parameters.

methods.name: qh_memsetup
methods.description: Prepares the memory system for operation.

methods.name: qh_memsize
methods.description: Adjusts or reports memory size parameters.

methods.name: qh_memstatistics
methods.description: Outputs memory usage statistics to a file.
